name: Julia Bösch
headline: Executive Chair & Founder Lookiero Outfittery Group | As European market leader in online personal shopping, we accompany over 3 million customers on their style journey. 🧡
summary:
Our vision: To give everyone the opportunity to discover their own style, while changing the online shopping experience fundamentally!

With precisely this vision in mind, Anna Alex and I founded the company Outfittery in 2012. Today we are the market leader in online personal shopping and serve over 1 million customers in a total of ten European markets. To have achieved this, makes me incredibly proud 👗👔 This is an invite to you to join me on my journey as a founder and CEO – and now, as Executive Chair, here on LinkedIn.

Since the beginning of 2025, Outfittery and Lookiero have joined forces – as one company, with two strong brands, one unified tech stack, one incredible team, and a clear ambition: to become Europe’s leading platform for personalized online shopping.

What you can expect from my profile:
🟧  Turning two companies into one. While little changes for our customers on the outside, we’re in the middle of one of the most exciting – and challenging – transformations in our company’s history. I’m growing into a new role myself and sharing honest behind-the-scenes insights: from building our joint platform to merging two company cultures.

🟧  I am passionate about the topic entrepreneurship, especially what it means to found a business. Curiosity and the courage to explore new paths have shaped my journey – and made this merger possible. On my LinkedIn account, I wan to tell you about my personal experiences, insights, and learnings from the past years of building and growing.

🟧  If your company grows 100%, you have to grow 100%! For me, personal growth as a founder and leader is the key. Regularly challenging yourself with new perspectives and new ways of thinking doesn’t just have a positive impact on you alone, but also on your interactions with other people. The entire company benefits!

→ You want to learn more about Outfittery and Lookiero? Check out our websites and get inspired: www.outfittery.de, www.lookiero.com

positions.description:
Formed through the merger of Outfittery and Lookiero, the group combines two strong brands with a shared mission: to revolutionize the way people shop by offering a highly personalized, effortless, and inspiring styling experience.

With a strong presence in 13 European markets and a team of expert stylists supported by cutting-edge technology and data science, the group empowers 3 million customers to discover their personal style.

company.name: Lookiero Outfittery Group
company.description:
Lookiero Outfittery Group is the European leader in online personal shopping.

Headquartered in Bilbao and Berlin, the group brings together two distinctive brands:  Lookiero and Outfittery. Each maintains its unique identity while sharing one mission: to deliver an exceptional, personalised fashion experience powered by advanced technology and the expertise of our stylist teams.

Operating across 12+ European markets, we serve millions of men and women, transforming the way they discover, enjoy and connect with fashion.

Our goal is simple: to make personal style effortless, inspiring, and tailored to every individual.
